verdict.rationale: Publishing a robots.txt is a fair question for any web-facing service, so the axis applies. The pack contains no evidence that INPI Portugal publishes one: the only probe checked llms.txt (HTTP 404), which is a different file and doesn't transfer to this story. Every docs item covers IP filing procedures, which are off-topic here.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service publishes a real robots.txt, so an agent can know what it may read before fetching anything
